Come Back To Yourself

1:1 coaching rooted in presence, not pressure — for people ready to live a little more free.

I work with people who've been carrying more than their share — helping you slow down, reconnect with what actually matters, and take the next right step from a grounded place instead of a frantic one. Sessions are honest and unhurried, always centered on where you actually are.

1. First

    A conversation, no charge

    Twenty minutes to hear what is going on and whether I am the right person for it. Often I am not, and I will tell you who might be.

  2. Then

    We agree what we are doing

    What you want to be different, how we will know, and how many sessions that is likely to take.

  3. After

    The work itself

    Fortnightly, an hour at a time, with something to try between them. You can stop whenever you like.

Something once a month

One short letter, usually a question worth sitting with. No course, nothing to buy.

Yes, send me the monthly letter. Unsubscribe any time.
